issues.detail: No independent source verdict has been supplied.

review_material.assessment: The source provides two temperature branches (T=10^-6 and T=1) for the incompressible kinetic energy E_i versus quench duration tau_Q, with fitted power laws and statistical details. The reviewer figure evidence confirms the fitted curves cover tau_Q from 100 to 1000 for both branches. This supports a quantitative interactive experiment with tau_Q as a numeric control and E_i as a numeric readout, with two branch-specific fixed conditions. The case is authoring-ready.

review_material.paper_scope: The paper establishes spontaneous quantum turbulence (SQT) in a newborn 2D Bose-Einstein condensate via the Kibble-Zurek mechanism, focusing on the incompressible kinetic energy spectrum and its universal scaling with quench duration. The selected cluster is the incompressible kinetic energy E_i at equilibration time as a function of quench duration tau_Q for two temperature branches (T=10^-6 and T=1).

anchors.support: E_i is defined as (1/2) integral |u_i(r, t_eq)|^2 d^2 r = integral E_i(k) dk.
Each data point is averaged over R=2000 (T=10^-6) and R=1000 (T=1) stochastic realizations; error bars denote 1 standard deviation.

readouts.definition: Total incompressible kinetic energy at equilibration time, defined as (1/2) integral |u_i(r, t_eq)|^2 d^2 r, where u_i is the incompressible component of the density-weighted velocity field.
readouts.name: E_i
readouts.statistic: Ensemble average over stochastic realizations (R=2000 for T=10^-6, R=1000 for T=1).
